reply.text:
Abs come from two things: a trained core and a low enough body fat for them to show, and the second part takes time and can't be rushed. For a 13-year-old, I'd skip anything about cutting down or dieting and focus on training well and eating enough to fuel growing and playing.

For the core itself, planks, dead bugs, leg raises and carries work well, and a few times a week is plenty. Squats, push-ups, pull-ups and sports build your midsection too. Sleep and regular activity matter more than any ab trick, and no workout makes abs show up fast, so be patient with it.

If you want to bring up food or body goals, a parent, doctor or school coach is the right person for that. I'm happy to help with exercises and technique, though. Want me to set up a core session for you?
